papers.title: Zero-Shot Heart Rate Variability Forecasting from Consumer Wearables Using Time Series Foundation Models
papers.what: Runs TimesFM, Chronos, and MOIRAI zero-shot on fragmented consumer-wearable HRV, adds a variability-preserving imputation for artifact gaps, and beats classical baselines at MASE 0.81 to 0.87 without fine-tuning over a 2-hour horizon on 49 people.

papers.title: MorphologyFM: A Foundation Model for Morphology-Aware Representation Learning from ECG and Pulse Oximetry Waveforms
papers.what: Pretrains a foundation model on paired ECG and SpO2 waveforms from MIMIC using morphology-guided masking, cross-modal learning, and contrastive alignment, so the representation keeps clinically meaningful waveform shape rather than just reconstructing raw values.
papers.builds_on: Masked Autoencoders Theory (Zhang 2023, 6INGKIJV); Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025, 2XWEG7AF)

papers.title: CAST: Game Solvers as Turn-Level Teachers for LLM Agents
papers.what: Turns a game solver's per-turn state-value changes into dense turn-level advantages for RLVR, giving LLM agents process-level credit in long-horizon games; under a soft-optimal solver this equals on-policy distillation using only scalar values.

papers.title: HumanCLAW: Can Vision-Language Models Act Through a Body?
papers.what: Decouples a VLM's action decisions from motor control and benchmarks nine VLMs on 1,218 embodied find-navigate-interact episodes across 41 scenes; the best reaches only 16.8% success, exposing a gap in embodied self-awareness rather than perception.
papers.builds_on: Flamingo (Alayrac 2022, SC8KWYVK); Agent AI Survey (Durante 2024, Z9WZPMNU)
